name: Lantern Home Services
tagline: One number for the whole house.
service_area: Wrenfield, Oak Row, Colliers Mill and the river side of Route 9
hours_note: Open 7am to 7pm, and a real person answers after hours
license: Licensed, bonded and insured — HVAC #M-40219, Electrical #E-11884

art_direction.identity: Warm bone canvas, espresso ink, one clay accent used as a spice. Wide Archivo signage lettering over Libre Franklin text. Hairline rules instead of boxes, two-pixel corners instead of pills, and bright daylight photography that breaks the container.
art_direction.type: Archivo held at wdth 112 for every heading; Libre Franklin at 1.0625rem/1.7 for body. Headings are semibold and tracked tight, never bold. Numbers are tabular.
art_direction.color: Bone is roughly seventy percent of any viewport. Clay (bg-accent) is reserved for the primary button, the house-plan pins and the four trade squares. Espresso (bg-deep) belongs to the closing band and the footer only. Never add a third brand colour, never a gradient.
art_direction.signature: The house plan — a drawn cutaway of a home with a numbered clay pin on the room each trade lives in, and the same numbers on the rows beside it. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Plain, specific and unhurried. Name the trade and the street. Give times and counts instead of adjectives. Two sentences maximum, no exclamation points, no hype.
